detail.value: I reset my password this morning and the new one is rejected on the sign-in page, although the reset email says it was changed.
Three of our analysts are bounced back to the sign-in page every time they open the reporting console, so nobody can pull today's figures.
The whole finance team lost access at 08:40 and the month-end close is due today; nobody in the group can authenticate.

closing.value: Please let me know what I should try next.
We have had no reply for two days and this is now blocking real work.
Please treat this as urgent: our contract states a two-hour response for access failures.
